newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian avg lending rate rises to 9.6 vs 9.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian avg lending rate rises to 9.6 vs 9.0 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate rose 60 basis points to 9.6 percent on Monday amid increased term borrowing.
Trade totalled 47.3 million kuna against a 50 million kuna demand. Some 21.3 million were term loans.
The interbank call money remained steady at 8.0 percent, while other financial institutions renewed call money deals at 7.0 and 13 percent.
Term rates ranged between 10.5-11.5 for eight-day loans and 16 percent for two-month money.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrates for Wednesday weaker at 6.2421 against the dollar and at 3.5751 against the German mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom 385-1-4557075
